facts.fact: The Municipal Council of Mbabane, the capital's council, pays for its own internet service: its audited accounts for the year to 31 March 2023 carry 'utility services - water, electricity, telephone and internet' of E10,514,346 (E10,257,972 the year before) among the Council's operating expenses, internet not shown separately.
facts.system: Municipal Council of Mbabane internet service

facts.fact: The Municipal Council of Mbabane's annual report for the year to March 2023 says its IT Section has automated various municipal activities, mail tracking among them, and has systems in place against cyber-attacks; it names no national or shared system that staff work in over the connection.
facts.system: Municipal Council of Mbabane internet service

facts.fact: One urban local authority, the Municipal Council of Mbabane in the capital, reports paying for internet at its own offices in the year to March 2023; the report gives no figure for other local authorities.
facts.system: Municipal Council of Mbabane internet service

facts.fact: The Municipal Council of Mbabane's annual report for the year to March 2023 says the Council's own Information Technology Section, within its Corporate Services Department, delivers its technology services.
facts.system: Municipal Council of Mbabane internet service

facts.fact: The Municipal Council of Mbabane's audited accounts for the year to 31 March 2023 meet its ICT costs from the Council's own operating budget: general maintenance of IT systems and equipment E3,649,160 (E4,168,708 the year before), and utilities including telephone and internet E10,514,346.
facts.system: Municipal Council of Mbabane internet service
